title: My Unsung Hero: Sanaa Kerroumi's Story

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham, and from Hidden Brain Media, this is My Unsung Hero.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆，来自隐形大脑传媒，这里是《我的无名英雄》。

sentences.en: Stories where one person reached out to help another in a time of need.
sentences.zh: 讲述普通人在他人需要时伸出援手的故事。

sentences.en: Hi Shankar, my unsung hero is a Frenchman.
sentences.zh: 嗨，香卡，我的无名英雄是一位法国人。

sentences.en: She had given me exactly what I needed in that time.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，她给予了我最需要的帮助。

sentences.en: I was fortunate enough to survive with the help of this man, this doctor, who went out of his way to help save my life.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能在一名医生的帮助下幸存下来，这位医生不辞劳苦地救了我的命。

sentences.en: Today's story comes from Sena Keroumi.
sentences.zh: 今天的底色故事来自塞娜·凯鲁米。

sentences.en: Some years ago, Sena was living in France, working on a PhD.
sentences.zh: 几年前，塞娜住在法国攻读博士学位。

sentences.en: One cold winter weekend, she and her friends took a break and spent the day at Disneyland Paris.
sentences.zh: 在一个寒冷的冬日周末，她和朋友们放松了一下，在巴黎迪士尼乐园度过了一天。

sentences.en: They stayed as long as they could, until it was finally time to catch the last train home.
sentences.zh: 他们尽可能地多玩了一会儿，直到终于到了赶末班车回家的时候。

sentences.en: She calls it the tram.
sentences.zh: 她把这叫作有轨电车。

sentences.en: One by one, all of Sena's friends got off at their stops, until she was the only one left.
sentences.zh: 塞娜的朋友们一个接一个在各自的车站下车，直到只剩下她一个人。

sentences.en: And I noticed that the tram was super empty, like there were just two people in there, two guys, both of them French, and I wear the hijab, so I really stand out.
sentences.zh: 我注意到电车空空如也，里面好像只有两个人，两个法国小伙子。我戴着头巾，所以非常显眼。

sentences.en: Whenever I go, I do stand out.
sentences.zh: 无论我走到哪里，我总是很显眼。

sentences.en: One of the men was in the front of the tram.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人在电车的前部。

sentences.en: The other sat a few rows behind Sena.
sentences.zh: 另一个人坐在塞娜身后几排的地方。

sentences.en: She didn't feel like either of them were paying her or her headscarf much attention,
sentences.zh: 她觉得他们两个都没怎么注意到她或她的头巾，

sentences.en: so she put on her headphones and looked out the window.
sentences.zh: 于是她戴上耳机，看着窗外。

sentences.en: Something, like maybe the switch, like the time between music or something like this, when you have the small silence.
sentences.zh: 突然，比如两首歌曲之间的间隙或者类似的时候，当你迎来一小段安静。

sentences.en: I heard something, and I turned and I saw this guy just being very agitated.
sentences.zh: 我听到了一些声音，转过头去，看到那家伙情绪非常激动。

sentences.en: He was waving his hands and swearing and just pointing in my direction,
sentences.zh: 他挥舞着双手，骂骂咧咧，手指着我的方向，

sentences.en: and I wasn't sure, like, if it was me or the other guy, because I didn't do anything that may, like, trigger him to do that.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定他是冲着我还是另一个人，因为我没做任何可能激怒他的事。

sentences.en: So I assumed that he was probably talking to the guy behind me.
sentences.zh: 所以我以为他可能是在跟坐在我后面的那个家伙说话。

sentences.en: I took my headphone off, and that's when I heard, like, all those very harmful words that he was saying.
sentences.zh: 我摘下耳机，就在那时，我听到了他说的那些极其伤人的话。

sentences.en: That we took the jobs, that we are making Europe uncivilized,
sentences.zh: 说我们抢了工作，说我们在让欧洲变得不文明，

sentences.en: that we are everything that is wrong with Europe and France.
sentences.zh: 说我们是欧洲和法国一切不好的根源。

sentences.en: At that moment, I was like, yes, this is about me.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我想，是的，这是冲着我来的。

sentences.en: This is definitely about me.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是冲着我来的。

sentences.en: I wasn't scared.
sentences.zh: 我并不害怕。

sentences.en: I was just numb and shocked.
sentences.zh: 我只是感到麻木和震惊。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't understand, why is this happening?
sentences.zh: 就像，我不明白，为什么会这样？

sentences.en: It didn't even cross my mind that I would be in danger,
sentences.zh: 我甚至没有想过自己会有危险，

sentences.en: but I was like, why?
sentences.zh: 但我当时想，为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: What did he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: Like, why?
sentences.zh: 为什么啊？

sentences.en: Just as Senna began to stand, the man who had been sitting behind her rushed to the front of the tram
sentences.zh: 就在塞娜刚要站起来时，坐在她身后的那个男人冲到电车前部，

sentences.en: and placed himself between her and the angry man.
sentences.zh: 挡在了她和那个愤怒的男人之间。

sentences.en: A few seconds, he was up front of me, and he kept on pushing the guy to the door of the tram.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，他就站到了我前面，一直把那个人往电车门的方向推。

sentences.en: He kept on saying, you don't touch her, you don't say those words to her, she's just a student.
sentences.zh: 他一直在说，你别碰她，你别对她说那些话，她只是一名学生。

sentences.en: And everything that's wrong with Europe is you.
sentences.zh: 而欧洲一切不对劲的地方，问题都在于你。

sentences.en: Like, this phrase, I remember it very clearly.
sentences.zh: 这句话，我记得非常清楚。

sentences.en: Everything that is wrong with Europe is people like you, not her.
sentences.zh: 欧洲所有的问题都在于像你这样的人，而不是她。

sentences.en: The man defending Senna kept the angry man from getting close to her.
sentences.zh: 保护塞娜的那个男人阻止了愤怒的男人靠近她。

sentences.en: At the beginning, he kept on pushing him toward the tramway door,
sentences.zh: 一开始，他一直把他往电车门推，

sentences.en: and at the same time yelling at the driver, stop the tram, this guy needs to get off at the next station.
sentences.zh: 同时冲着司机大喊，停下电车，这人需要在下一站下车。

sentences.en: Once the tram stopped, he pushed the man off the tram and then stood by the doors to make sure he couldn't get back on.
sentences.zh: 电车一停，他就把那个人推下了电车，然后站在门边，确保他无法再上来。

sentences.en: He stayed there, didn't talk to me, stayed by the door, just, like, watching me.
sentences.zh: 他就站在那里，没有跟我说话，守在门边，就这样，看着我。

sentences.en: This happens a lot when you are veiled, and especially in France, like,
sentences.zh: 当你戴着面纱时，这种情况经常发生，尤其是在法国，

sentences.en: when they see you as veiled, they really don't know how to interact with you.
sentences.zh: 当他们看到你戴着面纱时，他们真的不知道该如何与你交流。

sentences.en: They don't know what are your boundaries, so I'm assuming that's why he didn't come and talk to me.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道你的界限在哪里，所以我猜这就是他没有过来跟我说话的原因。

sentences.en: Although it would have not been a problem at all, I probably would have welcomed it,
sentences.zh: 尽管这完全没有问题，我甚至可能会欢迎，

sentences.en: but I'm pretty sure that that's the reason.
sentences.zh: 但我很确定这就是原因。

sentences.en: Senna was too shocked to say anything either.
sentences.zh: 塞娜也震惊得说不出话来。

sentences.en: She and the man stood in silence on the tram until her stop came.
sentences.zh: 她和那个男人在电车里默默站着，直到她的车站到来。

sentences.en: When she got out, the man followed and made sure she got into her building safely.
sentences.zh: 她下车后，那个男人一路跟着，确保她安全进入大楼。

sentences.en: Senna was still in too much shock to turn around and say thank you.
sentences.zh: 塞娜依然震惊得无法转身说声谢谢。

sentences.en: It was the very first time that I encountered something like it in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 这是我一生中第一次遇到类似的事情。

sentences.en: I heard stories.
sentences.zh: 我听过一些故事。

sentences.en: I, of course I did, like, I knew that it happens, but I never assumed that it would happen to me.
sentences.zh: 我当然听过，我知道这种事会发生，但我从没想过会发生在我身上。

sentences.en: And at the moment, like, even what the nice guy did didn't resist her.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，那个好心人做的事甚至没能让我回过神来。

sentences.en: Like, I was still so focused on what the bad guy said.
sentences.zh: 我仍然满脑子想着那个坏蛋说过的话。

sentences.en: Why was he attacking me?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要攻击我？

sentences.en: What did I do?
sentences.zh: 我做了什么？

sentences.en: And then somehow I was like, ah, but wait, I wasn't alone in this.
sentences.zh: 然后不知怎么的，我想，啊，但是等等，我并不是一个人。

sentences.en: There was another guy who kind of knew that I didn't do anything wrong,
sentences.zh: 还有另一个人，他知道我没有做错任何事，

sentences.en: that I didn't deserve the hatred and the violence.
sentences.zh: 知道我不应该承受仇恨和暴力。

sentences.en: And he actually defended me.
sentences.zh: 而且他真的站出来保护了我。

sentences.en: And then I said, wait, he had no reason to defend me.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，等等，他根本没有理由保护我。

sentences.en: He wasn't sharing the same beliefs and the same culture.
sentences.zh: 我们没有相同的信仰和相同的文化。

sentences.en: And yet he was there.
sentences.zh: 然而他就在那里。

sentences.en: He actually put himself in danger by doing that.
sentences.zh: 他甚至因此将自己置于危险之中。

sentences.en: He could have gotten hurt.
sentences.zh: 他本可能会受伤。

sentences.en: He could have gotten in so much trouble.
sentences.zh: 他本可能会陷入巨大的麻烦。

sentences.en: And he didn't think about that.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有考虑这些。

sentences.en: Every time Senna experienced Islamophobia after that day,
sentences.zh: 从那天起，每当塞娜经历恐伊症时，

sentences.en: she remembered the man who defended her.
sentences.zh: 她就会想起那个保护她的男人。

sentences.en: His kindness and courage gave her the strength to remain in France.
sentences.zh: 他的善良和勇气给了她留在法国的力量。

sentences.en: I don't remember it as the day where I was attacked by a stranger.
sentences.zh: 我不把它记为被陌生人攻击的那一天。

sentences.en: I remember it as the day where I was saved by a stranger.
sentences.zh: 我把它记为被陌生人拯救的那一天。

sentences.en: And that made all the difference.
sentences.zh: 而这改变了一切。

sentences.en: All the difference.
sentences.zh: 一切都不一样了。

sentences.en: Listener Senna Kiroumi.
sentences.zh: 听众塞娜·基鲁米。

sentences.en: Some years after the incident, Senna finished her PhD
sentences.zh: 事件发生几年后，塞娜完成了博士学位，

sentences.en: and moved back to our home country of Morocco.
sentences.zh: 并搬回了她的祖国摩洛哥。

sentences.en: When we spoke to her,
sentences.zh: 当我们与她交谈时，

sentences.en: she was working as an international management consultant.
sentences.zh: 她正在担任国际管理顾问。

sentences.en: We'd love to hear about your own Unsung Hero.
sentences.zh: 我们很想听听你自己的无名英雄的故事。

sentences.en: Use your phone to record your story in five minutes or less
sentences.zh: 用你的手机录下你的故事，时长五分钟或更短，

sentences.en: and email it to us at myunsunghero at hiddenbrain.org.
sentences.zh: 并将其发送至我们的邮箱：myunsunghero@hiddenbrain.org。

sentences.en: You can hear many more stories like this
sentences.zh: 你可以在我们的姊妹播客《我的无名英雄》中，

sentences.en: on our sister podcast, My Unsung Hero.
sentences.zh: 听到更多类似的故事。

sentences.en: Subscribe to that show
sentences.zh: 订阅那个节目，

sentences.en: and you never have to miss an episode.
sentences.zh: 你就永远不会错过任何一集。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham.
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: See you soon.
sentences.zh: 回头见。
